svg.title: Hysteria2 relay architecture
svg.desc: Client connects to relay VPS over Hysteria2 UDP QUIC, relay VPS forwards traffic to residential SOCKS5 over TCP, with multiple systemd node instances inside the VPS.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif
Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif

svg.text: 多实例中转到住宅 SOCKS5 出口，或保留 VPS 直连备线
